bugs_fixed_in_this_iteration: PlanUsageWidget: 'user is not defined' - Fixed by adding user to useAuth() destructuring
PlanUsageWidget: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading max)' - Fixed data structure mismatch
PlanUsageWidget: 'plans.map is not a function' - Fixed by using availablePlans array instead of plans object

root_cause_1.issue: user is not defined in PlanUsageWidget
root_cause_1.cause: The fetchData function used user?.entreprise_id but user was not destructured from useAuth()
root_cause_1.solution: Added user to the destructuring: const { api, user } = useAuth()

root_cause_2.cause: The component expected usage.usage.categories.max but the data structure from fetchData didn't include categories
root_cause_2.solution: Changed to use techniciens instead of categories, and fixed all property references to match actual data structure

root_cause_3.cause: setPlans() was setting an object but the component tried to use .map() on it
root_cause_3.solution: Changed to use availablePlans (which is an array) instead of plans
